answer: Up to about 20,000 events can arrive twice (offsets flushed every 10 s at 2,000 changes/s, so a single crash resends the last 10 seconds of publishes). The batch is published and acknowledged before the position is saved, so a crash in that gap replays it. The receiving side should keep, per key (order_id), the highest LSN applied, and skip any incoming event at or below that LSN. Source: pa_pattern_cdc_dual_writes.md, 'Log-Based CDC With Debezium'.
